login/logout

lockdown (immediate local containment); unlock and token revoke (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
no-argument TUI launch and completion generation (bash/zsh/fish/powershell/elvish)
config get/set/edit/validate (typed keys, atomic save, no secret fields)
instance add/list/use/remove (validated control-plane URLs)
device enroll/list/show/rename/labels/rotate-key/revoke
exec (local IPC or authenticated remote MCP; exact argv; explicit remote idempotency)
process start/status/logs/stop (bounded daemon-owned sessions, exact argv)
session list/show/open/attach/claim/release/give/cancel/close/terminate (local IPC; authenticated remote creation)
profile scan/list/show/login/test/start/resume (nine dialect-aware, credential-isolated adapters; readiness requires evidence and unsupported permissions/resume remain typed degraded)
approval list/show/watch/approve/deny (typed decisions; fresh browser passkey for mutations; /approve inbox + batch set commitment; deny-all without passkey)
policy show/validate/explain/preset/rule mutation (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
grants list/show/revoke/mint (bounded tool grants lift Ask only; mint is fresh-passkey admin; revoke/lockdown are local tightening)
transfer plan/send/list/status/cancel (authenticated control-plane MCP; destination replace only with overwrite_expected_sha256; no blind force; idempotency keys required for mutations)
mcp serve --stdio (authenticated configured issuer; bounded JSONL bridge)
service install/start/stop/restart/status/uninstall (user-level ownmeshd autostart only)
privileged broker install/status/uninstall (networkless native lifecycle: Linux systemd, macOS launchd, Windows SCM; native release receipts tracked separately)
update default/check/download/apply/status/channel (signed crash-safe self-update; network off by default)
workspace list/show/add/update/remove (device-local registry via ownmeshd IPC)

logs providers/query (authenticated local IPC; bounded, cursor-paged device log read across audit, journald, Docker/Podman, and process providers, plus Windows Event Log on Windows; no remote route and no remote log-body persistence)

notes: v1.2.25 stable surface contract. Completeness means every CLI surface admitted by this shipped registry has an implemented, fail-closed handler and every release-evidence waiver is resolved; it is not a claim that the aspirational specification or every optional packaging format is complete. E5 provides bounded PTY/process-tree and replay behavior. E6 provides nine structured profile adapters plus CLI profile flows. E7 provides bounded unified-diff review execution. E9 provides authenticated resumable transfer and the public transfer CLI. Device metadata mutation, authenticated remote exec/session creation, approval watch, profile management, bounded MCP stdio, and typed security-admin actions are supported. Sensitive approval, policy, unlock, and token mutations require an operation-bound fresh passkey decision and execute exactly once. Workspace create/list/show on the Control Plane overlay pending_activation versus active so remote execution cannot outrun Agent generation; device-local registry changes are published incrementally via the authenticated workspace.registry refresh (ADR 0014) so activation no longer waits for a reconnect. The local CLI/TUI workspace surface remains the device-local registry. E8's networkless broker lifecycle is implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows; Linux has a native root receipt, while macOS/Windows native release receipts and the full E8 public-route receipt remain open evidence. Live ChatGPT DCR/OAuth/passkey return has a manual compatibility receipt; reproducible automated E10 evidence remains open. SERVICE_VERSION 1.2.25. Doctor `--check-network` compares CLI and control-plane `/health` versions and now observes live Agent-route presence (daemon.agent_route; system.diagnose gains agent_route/agent_route_offline). Terminal operation failures reconcile their op-journal marker into a replayable failed receipt instead of stranding in_progress keys. Agent/transfer WebSocket connects are bounded with Happy Eyeballs-style IPv4 fallback (connect_timeout is a reconnect category), so a blackholed AAAA cannot park a reconnect forever. Linux disclosures: spawn resolution errors list the searched directories (service PATH plus user-local extras, never shell rc); EPERM spawns and doctor disclose RestrictNamespaces=yes and its operator drop-in; Linger=no warns that the ChatGPT route ends with the desktop session (lingering is never enabled automatically). Expired MCP Bearer tokens return HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate`. Generic and review command execution binds the approved invocation entry, backing object, exact argv0, and classification; drift returns a typed re-authorization error, and prepared executable custody closes the verify-to-spawn path race. Doctor and system.diagnose expose durable journal health (transition records and op-journal pressure) and profile-discovery status; systemd --user unit hardening (effective directives including drop-ins) is disclosed by doctor. Service lifecycle state is verified rather than assumed: `service start`/`stop` cross the observable daemon IPC boundary and return OWNMESH_E_SERVICE when the transition cannot be confirmed, macOS `stop` boots the KeepAlive LaunchAgent out of the user domain, and uninstall reports every launchctl/systemctl failure while retaining the descriptor and install record until the manager confirms the service inactive — a probe that proves nothing is classified unknown, never as absence. `service install` reconciles the descriptor actually registered with the OS against a versioned digest in user-service.json (systemd unit body, macOS plist, and the Windows task's structural action/trigger/settings identity), independent of whether the service is currently loaded. The Windows Scheduled Task binds the validated install-time config/state/runtime directories through typed `ownmeshd run --config-dir/--state-dir/--runtime-dir` arguments shared by the XML import and the /TR fallback, so an autostarted daemon can no longer split one installation into two state trees. Local IPC endpoints are validated before bind: Unix pathnames are checked against the platform sockaddr_un capacity with a deterministic short owner-only fallback, and Windows pipes are scoped by a SHA-256 digest of the normalized runtime path so distinct profiles cannot share a pipe. Structured-pipe sessions publish EOF and a real exit code, and a forced cutoff seals the streams so no output can appear after completion is reported. Workspace registry ACKs are sent only after Control Plane persistence, and approval decisions remain bound to the originating workspace generation through final DeviceRoom delivery. Unix registry locks are close-on-exec. Remote self-reentrant OwnMesh CLI execution is refused before spawn; routine OAuth refreshes preserve queued operation authority while explicit revocation still invalidates it; MCP sessions are catalog-revision fenced; additive diagnosis payloads retain bounded fail-closed required checks. macOS restricted Apple system binaries use a revalidated daemon-non-writable backing path instead of an unlaunchable private copy. v1.2.25 includes the v1.2.24 availability train: non-elevated command waits and control-plane-approved commands release the runtime mutex; command execution is bounded before admission/custody with queued-cancel safety; structured-session supervisor status classifies exited-but-unreaped children; Windows readiness uses a monotonic bounded wait; and all nine official profiles use source-backed dialect-aware structured adapter contracts with explicit evidence states. v1.2.25 additionally releases captured-authority elevated broker waits, durable orphaned-operation classification, Linux shebang compound custody, dual-era MCP and frozen catalog-v1 compatibility, bounded CIMD and RFC 9207 issuer responses, exact packaged-binary E2E, and signed machine-readable release evidence.
